Houston PPC Services

Houston PPC Agency becomes expensive if you do not manage it correctly. Keyword costs in competitive categories—legal, healthcare, home services, and financial services—can run significantly higher than national averages because of the volume of businesses bidding for the same searchers. An account that is not properly structured, continuously optimized, and managed by someone who knows what they are doing will burn through budget and produce leads of poor quality or no leads at all. We have taken over enough mismanaged Google Ads accounts to clearly see how budget gets wasted and why.

The businesses that get the best return from PPC in Houston are the ones with campaigns built around specific, high-intent audiences rather than broad keyword coverage. Targeting the right keywords, writing ad copy that qualifies visitors before they click, sending traffic to landing pages designed specifically for conversion, and continuously testing and refining — these are the practices that separate profitable PPC from expensive traffic generation. The difference in cost per lead between a well-managed and a poorly managed account in the same category can be three to five times.

Ready to Get More Qualified Leads From Paid Advertising in Houston?

Partner with the results-driven PPC specialists at Zoot Web Agency in Houston. We’ll audit your current campaigns and show you exactly where your budget is going and how to improve it.

Get My Free Proposal

Houston PPC Services

We manage data-driven paid advertising campaigns for Houston businesses built around qualified leads, measurable ROI, and complete transparency on every dollar spent.

Google Ads Management

Google Search Ads remain one of the highest-intent digital marketing channels available for businesses because users searching for specific services are often ready to take action immediately. We build and manage Google Ads campaigns with a strong Houston digital marketing services strategy focused on converting search intent into qualified inquiries while maintaining the lowest possible cost per lead. Our process includes detailed keyword research, negative keyword management, high-converting ad copy, bid strategy optimization, quality score improvements, and continuous testing of every campaign element that impacts performance and lead generation.

Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram)

Facebook and Instagram advertising reaches audiences at an earlier stage of the buying journey than search — but for many Houston businesses, paid social is the highest-volume lead source available at a reasonable cost. We build Meta campaigns around audience targeting rather than keyword intent, which means understanding who your ideal customer is, where they are in their decision process, and what content format gets them to act. We manage prospecting campaigns for new audiences and retargeting campaigns for people who have already visited your site or engaged with your content.

Keyword Research & Bid Strategy

Bidding on the wrong keywords is one of the most common and expensive PPC and SEO mistakes businesses make. We build keyword strategies around buyer intent, separating users who are researching from those who are ready to make a purchase or submit an enquiry immediately. High-intent keywords may cost more per click, but they typically generate stronger conversion rates and better return on investment. An effective SEO and negative keyword management are equally important, as excluding irrelevant search terms prevents wasted ad spend and allows your budget to focus on the keywords and audiences that drive real business results.

Landing Page Optimisation

A paid click landing on a generic service page will convert at a much lower rate than traffic directed to a purpose-built landing page. Our web design approach focuses on creating high-converting landing pages for PPC campaigns that align with the messaging of each advertisement, remove unnecessary distractions, and provide visitors with the exact information they need to take action. We continuously test headlines, form placement, social proof, page structure, and call-to-action copy to improve conversion rates and user experience. 

A/B Split Testing

Systematic testing is what separates PPC campaigns that improve over time from ones that plateau. We test ad headline variations, description copy, call-to-action language, landing page layouts, and audience targeting parameters — running controlled experiments that give us statistically reliable data on what performs better. Every change we make to a campaign is based on evidence from prior tests, not intuition. Over time, this continuous refinement produces compounding improvements in cost per lead and conversion rate that make your PPC investment more and more efficient.

Conversion Rate Optimisation

Getting the click is half the job. What happens after the visitor lands on your page determines whether the spend was worthwhile. We monitor conversion rates at every stage of the paid traffic journey — from click through to form completion through to qualified lead. When something in the funnel is underperforming, we identify it with session recording and heat map data, test fixes, and validate improvements with data before making them permanent. CRO applied to a PPC campaign has a multiplier effect: every improvement to conversion rate produces more leads from the same budget.

Display & Remarketing Campaigns

Display and remarketing campaigns serve a different purpose than search. They are most effective at re-engaging visitors who have already interacted with your brand — people who visited your site, watched a video, or engaged with an ad but did not convert. For Houston businesses with a longer sales cycle or a considered purchase decision, remarketing keeps your brand visible and top-of-mind as prospects work through their decision. We build remarketing audiences based on behaviour signals and serve targeted creative that matches where each visitor is in their consideration process.

YouTube Advertising

YouTube is the second-largest search engine in the world, and for Houston businesses where a product, service, or process benefits from visual demonstration, video advertising can be extraordinarily effective. We manage YouTube ad campaigns — including skippable in-stream ads, non-skippable bumper ads, and discovery ads — built around the specific audiences most likely to convert. YouTube advertising is also one of the most cost-effective awareness channels available, with CPMs that are substantially lower than traditional broadcast advertising and with targeting precision that television simply cannot match.

PPC Reporting & Analytics

Every client receives a detailed monthly PPC and social media performance report covering total ad spend, cost per click by campaign, conversion volume, cost per lead, audience engagement, and a clear breakdown of what strategies are performing best and what adjustments are being made. We connect advertising platforms, social media campaigns, and lead tracking systems wherever possible to measure actual revenue generated from specific campaigns instead of tracking only form submissions. Regular reporting calls are included with every account, and your account manager remains available 

Why Choose Zoot As Your Houston PPC Agency

We have audited enough PPC accounts to know exactly how budgets get wasted. The most common pattern: campaigns structured for clicks rather than conversions, keywords selected for volume rather than intent, landing pages that do not match the ad message, and reporting that shows impressive-looking click data disconnected from actual business results. Zoot builds PPC campaigns from the opposite starting point — what outcome does this Houston business need, and what campaign structure, keywords, landing pages, and bidding strategy are most likely to produce it at an acceptable cost per lead? See how strategic paid advertising campaigns improve lead quality through stronger targeting, conversion-focused landing pages, and data-driven budget allocation.

Lead Quality Over Click Volume

We optimise for qualified leads, not for the metrics that look best in a dashboard. High click volume with poor conversion rate is a waste of budget. We structure campaigns and select keywords specifically to attract visitors with genuine buying intent, and we monitor lead quality — not just volume — through regular communication with your sales team about what is coming through.

Full Spend Transparency

You see exactly where every dollar of your PPC budget is going. We provide full access to your ad accounts, clear monthly reports that break down spend by campaign and keyword, and a plain-language explanation of what each campaign is producing. There are no hidden management fees buried in your media spend and no inflated invoices with unclear line items.

Systematic A/B Testing

We run controlled experiments on ad copy, landing pages, audiences, and bid strategies continuously. Every test is designed to produce actionable data — not just variation for its own sake. Over time, this systematic refinement produces compounding improvements in cost per lead that make your PPC progressively more efficient as the campaign matures.

Dedicated PPC Specialist

Your account is managed by a PPC specialist who works on paid advertising full time — not a generalist who also handles your SEO, content, and social media. Your specialist knows your account history, your competitors, and your conversion data. They are the person on your monthly reporting call and the person managing your campaigns day to day.

Continuous Campaign Optimisation

PPC campaigns require active management to stay competitive. Search behaviour changes, competitors adjust their bids, and quality scores shift based on ad relevance and landing page experience. We monitor campaigns regularly, make data-driven adjustments to bids, keywords, and ad copy, and bring strategic recommendations to every monthly call based on what the data shows.

Month-to-Month Contracts

We do not lock clients into long-term PPC management contracts. We earn your business every month through the results we deliver. If the performance is not there, you are free to leave. That accountability ensures we are always working to improve your campaigns — not managing an account on autopilot and waiting for a contract to renew.

Frequently Asked Questions

Common questions from businesses about Houston PPC Agency, Google Ads, campaign costs, and what to expect from a paid advertising engagement with Zoot Web Agency.

What PPC platforms do you manage for Houston businesses?

We manage campaigns on Google Search, Google Display, Google Shopping, YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, and LinkedIn. The right platform depends on your business type, audience, and goals. For most Houston service businesses, Google Search delivers the highest-intent traffic and the fastest qualified lead results. Meta platforms are strong for reach, awareness, and categories where the buying decision benefits from visual content. We recommend the platform mix most appropriate for your specific situation.

How much should a Houston business spend on PPC advertising?

Budget depends on your industry, how competitive your keywords are in Houston, and what cost per lead is acceptable for your business. Some Houston categories — legal, medical, home services — have high keyword costs because of the value of each client. In these categories, a meaningful budget (typically $2,000 to $5,000 or more per month in ad spend) is required to generate reliable lead volume. We will tell you honestly what we think is required in your category before you commit to anything.

How quickly can PPC generate leads for my Houston business?

Unlike SEO, paid advertising can generate leads from the first week — sometimes from the first day a campaign goes live. The early weeks focus on optimisation: refining keywords, adjusting bids, testing ad copy, and improving landing page conversion rates. Lead volume and quality typically improve significantly in the first 30 to 60 days as these optimisations compound. We set realistic expectations in the proposal so you know what to expect at each stage.

Will you take over my existing Google Ads account?

Yes. If you have an existing Google Ads account, we start with a thorough audit to understand the current campaign structure, keyword strategy, historical performance, and where budget has been wasted. In most cases we find significant opportunities to improve targeting, reduce wasted spend on non-converting keywords, and improve landing page conversion rates. The audit findings inform our initial strategy and give us a baseline to measure improvements against.

How do you ensure we get quality leads, not just clicks?

Quality control starts with keyword strategy — bidding on terms with genuine buying intent rather than broad informational queries. It continues with ad copy that qualifies visitors before they click — describing who the service is for, what it costs, and what the process looks like. Purpose-built landing pages with clear expectations reduce further the number of non-qualified visitors who submit a form. We also ask for regular feedback from your sales team on lead quality so we can adjust targeting if needed.

Do you charge a percentage of ad spend or a flat management fee?

We charge a flat monthly management fee rather than a percentage of spend. This means our incentive is to produce leads efficiently — not to increase your spend to grow our revenue. The management fee covers all campaign strategy, build, optimisation, testing, and monthly reporting. Ad spend goes directly to the platforms and is separate. We will be explicit about both numbers in the proposal.

What happens to my campaigns if I stop working with Zoot?

You own your ad accounts. If you ever decide to stop working with us, you take your Google Ads account, your Meta Business Manager, and all campaign assets with you. We do not retain ownership of anything built on your accounts, and we will provide a full transition briefing to whoever takes over management. Nothing is held back.

How do you measure PPC success beyond click-through rate?

Click-through rate is a quality indicator but not a success metric by itself. We measure success by cost per lead, lead quality, conversion rate from landing page visits, and ultimately revenue generated from paid traffic. Where we can connect Google Ads or Meta data to your CRM, we do — giving you full revenue attribution by campaign and keyword. Monthly reports present all of this in plain language tied to your actual business outcomes.

Can you run Google Shopping campaigns for my Houston eCommerce business?

Yes. Google Shopping requires a different approach from search campaigns — product feed optimisation, bidding strategies by product margin and conversion rate, and continuous refinement of product titles and descriptions to match shopping queries. We manage Shopping campaigns for Houston-based online retailers and combine them with search, display, and remarketing for a complete paid search strategy across the purchase funnel.

How do I get started with PPC management in Houston?

Fill out the form on this page. If you have an existing Google Ads or Meta account, we will conduct a free audit and send you a plain-language findings report showing exactly what is costing you money and what we would do differently. If you are starting from scratch, we will assess your goals and market and put together a recommended campaign structure and starting budget. Either way, you will have a clear picture before committing to anything.
